m: The {Pirate} marches down the vine {Staircase} of the {Jungle} pounding a giant *drumbeat* on a barrel: PENG, PENG, PENG. Every monkey answers with its own *drumbeat* until the trees shake loose coconuts. A parrot screeches his family name back at him, "**Peng**! **Peng**!", and the whole jungle joins the **Peng** family band.

The {Baker} slides down the steamy {Staircase} of the {Spa} and spots a *pulled weed* growing out of a mud bath. A giant *helping hand* rises from the mud, grabs it, and they **pull out** the weed together, roots and all, flinging mud on every guest. The roots keep coming, metres of them, until they **pull out** a rubber duck at the end.

The {Pirate} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} riding a painted *horse* and props up a fake *nameboard* reading "Honest Bank". He swaps real coins for chocolate ones and tells every customer it's a great deal. When the chocolate melts in their pockets, they realise how badly he managed to **cheat** them, and the *horse* winks: a born **cheat** too.

The {Firefighter} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} into the {Jungle} and finds a *small table* bursting into flames. A *right hand* reaches out of the fire and lifts a blazing bird: a **phoenix**! She sprays it with her hose, but the **phoenix** only sneezes sparks, shakes off the water, and rises from the ashes, singing.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and finds an old owl sweeping it with a tiny *broom*. With every sweep, the owl brushes worries off each waiting patient's *heart*, and they become calm and **wise**. The hunter lowers his rifle and lets the owl sweep him too; he walks out so **wise** he forgets why he came.

The {Magician} sweeps up the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house where a *woman* holds a giant *plum* like a microphone. She shouts the day's gossip into the *plum* and it booms across the water to every fish. Cameras pop out of the lake: the **media** has arrived, and the magician becomes front-page news for the **media** by morning.

The {Pirate} bursts out of the {Trapdoor} on the {Lake} pier and finds a *standing person* balancing on a single water lily. The pirate takes off his hat and stares in awe; every frog on the lake applauds. "How do you do that?" he asks, and he can't stop to **admire** the trick. He sits down to **admire** it all afternoon, forgetting to plunder anything.

The {Firefighter} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} and finds a *standing heart* glowing red with **anger**, stomping beside a *fountain*. It kicks the fountain so hard that the *fountain* sprays boiling steam over the dodgems. She hoses the furious heart down, but its **anger** only fizzes louder, and the carousel horses flee in fright.

The {Pirate} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} house and sees a *fortune stick* tumbling through the air. A giant *helping hand* swoops down; the pirate and the hand both **pounce** at the same time and miss, crashing into the deep end. The stick lands on a cat, which looks at them both and decides to **pounce** on the pirate instead.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} where a *herald* blows a trumpet and announces each boxer's **age**. A dentist counts the *teeth* of every fighter to check: "This one has forty years of *teeth*!" The lifeguard opens her mouth, the *herald* counts, and proudly bellows her **age** to the crowd.

The {Cheerleader} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Museum} on a galloping *horse*, waving a *district map* like a pom-pom. She chants, kicks, and rides the horse in circles until every pigeon flees. She uses the map to **drive away** the burglars too, swatting them all the way into the next district: "Go, go, **drive away**!"

The {Shepherd} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut beside her last strip of *sun-dried meat*, hugging it tight. Her *standing heart* thumps with love for it, guarding it from seagulls. When a gull swoops, she shields the snack with her body: she will **cherish** it forever. She names it, kisses it, and **cherish** wins over hunger.

The {Hunter} gallops up the {Staircase} of the {Tower} chasing a tiny *pig*, but the *pig* turns around, puffs out its chest, and charges him like a knight. It rescues a princess, saves the guards, and poses on the battlements: so **heroic**! The hunter kneels and gives the **heroic** *pig* a medal instead of a cage.

The {Yogi} descends to the {Basement} of the {Mansion} to meditate, when a *sudden flash* of light blinds everyone. A *helping hand* shoots out and claps over her eyes to **cover** them. Then it grabs a bedsheet and tries to **cover** the whole mansion, chandeliers and all, until only the Yogi's toes stick out.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} juggling *two sheaves* of wheat at once, one in each hand. Then he swaps them for coins, still juggling **both** wheat and money together. A banker shouts "Choose one!", but the juggler refuses: he keeps **both**, plus the banker's hat.

The {Yogi} springs out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink} with a *kicking foot*, landing beside a twirling *dancer*. Together they **leap** across the ice, higher and higher, until their heads poke the ceiling lights. The *dancer* does a triple spin; the Yogi tries one giant **leap** and lands in a heap of snow.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} and finds a *lying man*, stiff as a plank, covered in honey. The bees think he's a **corpse** and start building wax walls around him. Suddenly the "**corpse**" sneezes, sits up, and asks for toast, and the Sheriff faints instead.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and every swimmer freezes. On the diving board stands a *stern face* glaring down, silent and **solemn**. Nobody splashes; even the inflatable flamingo stops bobbing. The sailor tries a joke, but the *stern face* stays so **solemn** that the water itself goes still.

The {Pirate} pops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} wrapped in a fluffy *towel*. A *white dove* flies by carrying a tiny **handkerchief**, and the pirate sneezes so hard his towel flies off. The dove kindly offers the **handkerchief**, which the pirate uses to blow his nose with a foghorn honk.

The {Sheriff} rides a *horse* down into the {Basement} of the {Beehive}, where a *historian* sits with a steering wheel. "Let me **drive**!" says the historian, and he steers the horse through honey tunnels, narrating the history of every turn. They **drive** so fast the bees need speeding tickets.

The {Baker} digs into the {Basement} of the {Tower}, piling up *soil* to build walls, while a *nanny* bosses him around. "Thicker! Higher!" she shouts, and the soil mounds become a mighty **fortress**. The nanny moves in with a cradle, and nobody gets past the **fortress** without a nap.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} onto a *lying man* asleep beside a *sprouting field*. Every year the field sprouts a new crop of yetis who sit down for the annual **session** of the Yeti Parliament. The lying man yawns: he has slept through every **session** since 1890.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} with a huge *grin* stretched ear to ear. The *grin* is so wide it lights up the night, and her sheep start dancing. Guests open their windows and catch it too: everyone in the inn is **happy**, and the **happy** grin floats off like a moon.

The {Hunter} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} into the {Waiting Room} and finds a giant *heart* handing out free cupcakes to everyone. "Do me a **favour**," it says, and gives the Hunter its last cupcake. He feels so warm that he does every patient a **favour** too, carrying them in on his back.

The {Tsar} clambers out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} clutching a *bamboo book* tied with string. He unrolls it into a tiny **booklet** of royal decrees, and each slat clacks like castanets as he reads. The peasants applaud, so he publishes a **booklet** every hour until the hut is stuffed with them.

The {Chef} dives into the {Basement} of the {Pool} where a *standing person* counts jars by *headcount*: "One, two, three hundred!" They **store** pickles, jams, and soups under the water, stacked to the ceiling. The Chef adds a cake, and the counting person yells, "Out of room to **store** it!" as everything floats away.

The {Pirate} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} waving a *ticket*, when a gust of *wind* snatches it. The ticket and every cat's whisker **flutter** off into the sky like confetti. The pirate chases them, but his hat, beard and flag **flutter** off too, until he stands there bald and blinking.

The {Sailor} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar}, where a giant *mulberry* tree has burst through the roof. Silkworms ride its branches like pilots, munching **mulberry** leaves. The Sailor shakes the tree, and a purple rain of **mulberry** fruit splats over every aeroplane below.

The {Shepherd} lounges on the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} beside a closed *gate*, where a *tree* grows right in the doorway. Nobody can get in, so everyone is **idle**: bankers nap, coins snore, and the tree yawns. The shepherd hangs a hammock in the branches and stays **idle** until next Tuesday.

The {Tsar} stomps into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and finds his *standing heart* weeping into a bowl of bitter *ginseng*. It sobs that its crown is lost, its castle leaks, and its soup is cold: utterly **miserable**. The Tsar tastes the ginseng and becomes even more **miserable**; both weep until the basement floods.

The {Juggler} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} carrying a *lucky charm* that sprays *water drops* everywhere. Every drop scrubs the hairy yetis until they sparkle white. The cave becomes so **clean** it squeaks, and the yetis refuse to get dirty again: **clean** fur only!

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} hut following muddy prints from a *kicking foot*. They lead straight into an old *ancestral hall*, where she finds a faint **trace** of every escaped animal: a feather, a fin, a sock. She follows each **trace** until she has her whole zoo back.

The {Baker} charges up the {Staircase} of the {Fort} when a blazing *comet* crashes into his flour sack. A *strong arm* grabs the comet and kneads it into the dough, and the bread grows, booming and bursting with life: **thriving**! Soon the fort is a **thriving** bakery with fiery loaves in every window.

The {Baker} rolls out a red carpet on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} for the *guest of honour*, a goat wearing a crown. Every chimney puffs confetti, and the Baker serves a cake taller than the chimneys. The **guest** eats it all, plus the tablecloth, and the innkeeper declares her **guest** of the year.

The {Pirate} hops up the {Staircase} of the {Inn} one *step* at a time, and at every *step* he flips a *page* of his treasure map. He stops **frequently** to check it, so frequently that the stairs start keeping score. By the top, he has stopped a thousand times; the innkeeper sighs that he visits **frequently**.

The {Chef} stomps up the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse}, where a *standing person* swings a *crowbar* at his canoes. They have been enemies for years, full of **hatred**, over a stolen soup recipe. The Chef throws a ladle, the crowbar clangs, and their **hatred** bubbles until the boats themselves start fighting.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Fort}, where a round *stone* rolls over a pile of *hemp*. He waves his wand and the stone spins faster, faster, to **grind** the hemp into dust that clouds the fort. The soldiers sneeze in unison; the stones keep on to **grind** their swords into butter knives.

The {Dentist} pops through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} road, where her *little brother* runs along the *road* with a toothbrush. He reaches her and must **hand over** the brush, but a crab grabs it first. Now the crab must **hand over** it, and a whole relay of crabs passes it down the beach.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} carved into a *hillside*, where a giant *fang* glints in the dark. It belongs to an **evil** yeti cackling over stolen sheep. The Shepherd yanks out the *fang* with pliers, and the **evil** yeti lisps so badly nobody can take him seriously.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swamp} and lands on a skateboard. A *helping hand* shoves him straight at a *schoolkid* on a lily pad, and they **bump into** each other with a mighty SPLASH. Frogs fly everywhere; then the frogs **bump into** each other and the swamp becomes a bumper-car rink.

The {Ninja} crouches in the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut, sketching a secret plan. A *helping hand* holds a *tool*, a quivering pencil, and scribbles the first **draft** of an attack on the sandcastle across the bay. The tide washes it away, so they write a new **draft** on a surfboard.

The {Gardener} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Casino} wearing a gold *royal robe* that trails behind her. *Water drops* pour from the ceiling, she slips, and she starts to **roll** across the floor like a dice. She knocks over the roulette wheel, and every chip, card and croupier begins to **roll** after her.

The {Zookeeper} springs out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} holding a *spring planter* full of tulips that open like trumpets. She points them at the *sky* and they **play music**, a booming brass band. The clouds dance, the ducks sing, and the boats **play music** too by banging their oars.

The {Shepherd} marches down the {Staircase} into the {Dunes}, following a long *road* beside a *wavy river* of sand. She and her sheep **patrol** the desert in a neat line, saluting every cactus. When a camel sneaks past, the whole flock spins around and goes back on **patrol**, baa-ing like sirens.

The {Yogi} poses on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} beside a dapper *gentleman* holding a blank *page*. She breathes out, and the page fills with every **colour** in the rainbow, splattering the gentleman's suit. He sneezes, and **colour** sprays across the whole mansion like fireworks.

The {Juggler} pops out of the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach}, where a *standing knife* trims a *trimmed hedge* into a perfect pill shape. The hedge pill is a giant **dose** of medicine for a sick whale. The juggler tosses the **dose** into the waves, and the whale burps, cured.

The {Juggler} climbs through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach}, where a *debt collector* waits with a list. To pay, he weaves a *silk thread* into a golden trophy, his greatest **achievement**. The collector weeps, frames it, and announces his **achievement** over a megaphone to every surfer.

The {Gardener} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} onto a *workbench* covered in seashells. Each villager brings a *shell* to **contribute** to a giant shell statue of a whale. The gardener adds her watering can, and even the fish **contribute** bubbles until the statue begins to float.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} treehouse when a *wind* blows a *sickbed* up to her, wheels spinning. In it lies a monkey howling with laughter, completely **crazy**. The wind spins the bed in circles and the Firefighter starts laughing too, until the whole jungle goes **crazy**.

The {Pirate} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} and spreads out an animal *hide* like a sled. He shovels *soil* off the roof until it tilts into a steep **slope**, then whooshes down it, cannonballs bouncing after him. He hits the moat and the whole fort slides down the **slope** behind him like a toboggan.

The {Cheerleader} bounces up the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} where a sizzling *barbecue* smells of grilled fish. One giant *eye* pops out of the grill and spins around: "**Look**!" Every cat stops licking and stares. The cheerleader shakes her pom-poms and chants, "**Look**, look, look!" until the eye winks and the fish fly onto every plate.

The {Juggler} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} juggling a long *lance* when a *sparrow* lands on its tip. The sparrow chirps and the lance swings down to **cut off** a yeti's ponytail. Furious, the yeti tries to **cut off** the juggler's escape, but the sparrow carries the juggler away by his collar.

The {Robot} clanks up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} carrying a tiny *campfire* in its chest. It sneezes sparks and *flames* leap onto the curtains, the piano, and the butler's wig. Everything begins to **ignite** in a dazzling chain, and the robot cheers, pressing a button to **ignite** the chandelier as a finale.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} juggling sausages over a smoking *barbecue*. He gets distracted by a cat and every sausage drops in, crackles, and turns black and **burnt**. The cats sniff, sneeze soot, and refuse to eat anything **burnt**, so the juggler wears the sausages as a necklace.

The {Dentist} rises through the {Trapdoor} into the grand **palace hall** of the {Yen Exchange}, gold columns glinting. On a golden *throne* sits the bank manager, swinging a *war club* at anyone with crooked teeth. The dentist ducks, polishes his teeth, and the whole **palace hall** echoes with a sparkling smile.

The {Wizard} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Lake} house, where a *standing person* dresses up in a grey costume beside an *elephant handler*. The "elephant" is clearly **fake**: two people under a blanket with a hose for a trunk. The handler swears it's real, but the Wizard pulls the blanket and reveals a **fake** in tap shoes.

The {Lifeguard} slips into the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel} where a *tree* grows through a *mortise* hole in the floorboards. Its long branches droop like hair: a weeping **willow**, sobbing onto the bunk beds. The lifeguard hands it a tissue and the **willow** blows its nose so loudly the backpackers wake up.

The {Sailor} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} where a mountain of *gold coins* glitters. He reaches for one, and CLICK: every coin snaps shut like a giant **lock** around his wrist. He pulls and tugs, but each coin is a tiny **lock**, and he clanks out dragging a chain of gold.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut as a *full jar* of jam rolls down the *road* toward the sea. It squeezes every crab and tourist ahead of it into the water, a huge sticky wall. The jar shouts "Move!" to **force** them out of the way, and the baker uses a rolling pin to **force** the lid back on.

The {Pirate} sprawls on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} on a striped animal *hide*, reading a *page* of poetry aloud. The cannon crew nods: "**Quite** good." He reads another page, and they nod harder: "**Quite** excellent!" Soon the whole fort is quite moved, quite weepy, and quite late for battle.

The {Hunter} lies on the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} as purple *twilight* swirls overhead like smoke from a slot machine. The sun sinks, the neon blinks, and he gets so dizzy he starts to **faint**. Every gambler beside him feels faint too, and one by one they **faint** in a pile of chips.

The {Cheerleader} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mint}, where a *right hand* and a *strong arm* push a stubborn coin toward the press. She chants, "Go, coin, go!" to **urge** it on, and the arm flexes and pushes harder. The coin finally rolls in, and every coin behind it begs her to **urge** them too.

The {Chef} carries a silver tray up the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} temple with a rolled *petition* on it like a fancy dish. At the top, a gorilla king waits. The chef bows and lifts the lid to **present** it with a drum roll, and the gorilla eats the *petition*, so the chef has to **present** dessert instead.

The {Sailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} while a wrinkly *elder* lost his false teeth. A giant *helping hand* rummages through every boat, net, and barrel to **search** for them. They **search** the gulls, the waves, and the sailor's beard, until the elder smiles: they were in his mouth all along.

The {Cheerleader} sprints up the {Staircase} of the {Inn} with a pot of *violet* flowers and a *strong arm* sticking out of her backpack. The arm sweeps, mops, and paints while she cheers: so **hardworking**! By dawn the inn is spotless, and the *violet* flowers are polishing the windows, equally **hardworking**.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a *sentry* guards a jar of cookies. Every time a yeti reaches for one, the sentry bonks it with a spear and shouts, "**Give up**!" The yetis sob but finally **give up** sweets forever, and the juggler juggles carrots instead.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Piazza} and lands on a *horse* with a big *plus sign* painted on its rump. Every time he pulls the reins, another horse is added: plus one, plus one. Soon he must **drive** a carriage pulled by forty horses, and they **drive** circles around the fountain.

The {Pirate} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} holding a *ticket* to a beauty contest. He splashes *water drops* on his face, combs his beard with a fish, and paints his nails. The cats gasp: he's so **pretty**! He wins first prize and the cats crown him the most **pretty** pirate alive.

The {Yogi} meditates in the {Basement} of the {Inn} beside a *side dish* of salty peanuts. Every peanut makes her *yawn* wider, until her mouth is big enough to **drink** the whole barrel of tea. She tips it in, gulp gulp, and the innkeeper serves her the next barrel to **drink** too.

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower} dragging a wooden *trough* full of soup. At the top waits a general wearing a name badge: **Cao**. The Tsar pours the soup over his head as tribute, and General **Cao** licks his moustache and declares it delicious.

The {Dentist} digs into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} and finds a single *flower* growing out of a crate of toothbrushes. She waters it with mouthwash, and the **flower** blooms bigger and bigger, filling the whole warehouse with petals. Now every customer gets a free **flower** with their filling.

The {Zookeeper} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Beehive} carrying a tiny lion *cub* wrapped in a blanket. She tiptoes past the sleeping bees, **careful** not to buzz or bump. The *cub* sneezes, the bees wake, and the Zookeeper whispers, "Be **careful**!" as she glides past them on tiptoe.

The {Robot} creaks up the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} holding a *springy twig* that bends and bounces. It touches the robot's metal chest, and suddenly the robot goes all **soft** and wobbly like jelly. It slumps onto a boat, hugs a pillow, and declares itself the most **soft** robot ever built.

The {Lifeguard} slips into the {Basement} of the {Piazza} cafe, where a *standing person* weighs people on a *balance scale*. She steps on one side, her twin on the other, and the scale stays dead level: the **two** of them, perfectly matched. A third cousin hops on and the scale flips, so it stays just the **two**.

The {Magician} shoots through the {Trapdoor} into the {Jungle} holding the *firstborn* baby of the **Meng** family, swaddled in leaves. He pulls a top hat off the baby and out pop a hundred monkeys chanting the family name. The jungle bows to young **Meng**, crowned eldest heir of all the trees.

The {Firefighter} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Pool} house and finds a tiny *mansion* made entirely of *meat*. It's been there for months and is green, fuzzy and **rotten**, buzzing with flies. She sprays it with her hose, and the **rotten** mansion collapses in a stinky wave that empties the pool.

The {Yogi} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} holding a silk *cocoon*. A tiny *strong arm* punches out of it, then a second, and out wriggles a baby caterpillar wearing a nappy: so **young**! It flexes, rows a boat, and the Yogi bows to the **young** champion.

The {Juggler} shoots up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} with a *kicking foot* and *twin blades* strapped to his shoes. He has a plan, and now he must **carry out** every step: he kicks open every vault and slices every coin into perfect halves. The bankers gape as he whistles and stops to **carry out** the last step in one breath.

The {Juggler} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} bar where a stalk of *bamboo* stands over a *ploughed field* of sand. Each bamboo stalk is a name in the town **register**, and he juggles them to sign up every crab. A crab who isn't on the **register** gets ploughed under the sand.

The {Magician} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} carrying a long *cane*, while a *cow* floats past on an inflatable ring. He taps the water with the cane and fifty more cows appear, splashing. He must **herd** them all into the shallow end, and the cows **herd** him back into the deep end.

The {Lifeguard} jogs down the {Staircase} of the {Stadium}, where *icicles* hang from a frozen *palace*. Every athlete breathes out clouds and shivers. She licks an icicle and the whole stadium becomes delightfully **cool**, so cool that the referee wears sunglasses and skates across the pitch, looking very **cool**.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} tower, watching a *cow* nibble a tiny *seedling*. Suddenly goats, pigs and chickens climb up after it until the roof is packed with **livestock**. The roof creaks, and the Sheriff lassoes all the **livestock** back down the vines, one moo at a time.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Piazza} beside a *standing person* holding a polished *jade tablet*. The tablet reflects the sunset so beautifully that the pigeons applaud. "**Fine** work," says the standing person, and the juggler toasts with a teacup of **fine** wine.

The {Ninja} sneaks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} where a *woman* in a mud mask reads name tags. A *pointing finger* glides down the list and stops at a long, graceful **female name**: Nana. The ninja insists that's his **female name** too, and nobody dares argue with a ninja in a robe.

The {Ninja} creeps down the {Staircase} into the {Lagoon} beside a *farm*, where *water drops* are boiling into soup. The soup grows so **thick** that the ninja's sword gets stuck upright in it. Cows wade in and become a **thick** stew, mooing, while ducks paddle around like croutons.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} on a *square* patch of *grass* that smells of roses. She sprays it, and the scent explodes: every aeroplane smells **fragrant** as perfume. Pilots float out of cockpits sniffing, and the runway becomes **fragrant** enough to bottle.

The {Gardener} burrows into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and builds a tiny *tower* out of *grain stalk* bundles. On every stalk she writes a sentence, a rough **draft** of her novel. The tower topples, the sentences scramble, and she calls the new mess her second **draft**.

The {Jockey} gallops up the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and casts a *fish hook* into the water. Instead of fish, she pulls up a stalk of green **bamboo**, then another and another. Soon the pool is a jungle of **bamboo**, and a panda floats by on a lilo, munching.

The {Firefighter} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} on a *return trip* to the *moon*, which hangs above the deep end. She belly-flops onto it with her round **belly**, and the moon bounces her back. She makes the trip again and again until her **belly** is shaped like a full moon.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} as a *lost arrow* whizzes past and trips her *kicking foot*. She tumbles off the roof to **fall** onto a yeti's head. The yeti topples too, and the whole yeti family **fall** like dominoes down the mountain.

The {Lifeguard} jogs down the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} along a *road* of conveyor belts, holding a *gauze net*. Her job is to **patrol** for runaway rubber ducks. She nets dozens, but more escape, so she has to **patrol** all night on roller skates.

The {Chef} trudges up the {Staircase} of the {Waiting Room} and finds a *weeping willow* growing from the carpet. Its branches **droop** onto every patient, tickling their noses. The Chef props them up with spaghetti, but the spaghetti also starts to **droop**, and soon everyone wears noodle wigs.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} raising a *toast* to the rules. Every animal lines up on the *road* below and promises to **obey**: no gambling, no biting, no stealing chips. A monkey refuses, so the zookeeper clinks her glass, and the monkey bows and starts to **obey**.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island}, where a *stream* glows under the *moon*. He presses his finger to it and feels a **pulse**: thump, thump, the island is alive! The stream throbs, the palm trees nod in rhythm, and the Magician's top hat bounces with every **pulse**.

The {Magician} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} with a *badger* in his hat. The badger stands against a sheet, casting a *silhouette* of a dashing prince. Everyone admires its **appearance**, but when the sheet drops, the badger is just a badger, with a mustache drawn on to improve its **appearance**.

The {Baker} digs into the {Basement} of the {Island} and finds a dark *tree* growing upside down. A *white dove* nests in its roots, cooing. The tree is an ancient **cypress**, and its scent is so strong that the bread smells of **cypress** for a hundred years.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a dark cell, where a *prowling dog* guards the bars. She's in **prison** for stretching too close to the dinosaurs. The dog prowls, she stretches, and she slips between the bars like noodles, escaping the **prison** in a perfect downward dog.

The {Tsar} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut, where a *prowling dog* sniffs a patch of *moss*. "What's under it?" asks the Tsar. "**Guess**!" barks the dog. The Tsar guesses gold, a crown, a pie; the dog digs up a sock. "Wrong **guess**," it says, and wears it as a hat.

The {Lifeguard} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} as a *herald* announces that a coin has lost its shine. Her *standing heart* swells with **pity** for the poor dull coin. She polishes it, sings it a lullaby, and soon every banker weeps with **pity** too.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse}, where a *guard post* stands next to a beating *heart*. He asks the guard what the heart is guarding, and the guard scratches his helmet, completely **puzzled**. The heart beats out a riddle in Morse code, and all three stay **puzzled** till dawn.

The {Tailor} spins up the {Staircase} of the {Tower} on a potter's wheel, carrying lumps of clay dug from a *hillside*. At every step she throws a new piece of *pottery*: vases, jugs, a teapot shaped like a goose. The tower fills with **pottery** to the roof, and she stitches tiny jackets for every piece of **pottery**.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and meets a pair of enormous *horns* rising from the water. A hairy **beast** surfaces, wearing a lifejacket. It roars, the canoes flee, and the Sheriff pins his badge on its horns, deputising the **beast** to guard the docks.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and pitches a **tent** made of one enormous *towel*. For guy-ropes she uses a horse's *long hair*, braided tight. Wind from a jet engine fills it like a balloon, and the **tent** floats off the runway with the jockey waving inside.

The {Sheriff} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} carrying a *side dish* of jelly beans. The bees glue each bean to the honeycomb as **decoration**, sparkly and colourful. Soon the Sheriff's hat, boots and badge are covered too, and he jingles like a walking **decoration**.

The {Dentist} pops out of the {Trapdoor} on the {Island} and borrows a giant *shell* full of pearls from a crab. A *stand-in* dentist signs the papers so she doesn't have to. Now the crab chases the stand-in around the palm trees, waving the **loan** contract: pay back the **loan**, with interest in seaweed!

The {Chef} grills on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} under a *double sun*, two blazing suns side by side. The heat makes everything grow: crops sprout, planes multiply, the business booms, all **prosperous**. The Chef sells sunny pancakes to every pilot and becomes the most **prosperous** cook in aviation.

The {Shepherd} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} holding a plate of *leftovers*. A *right hand* points at each scrap, and she begins to **narrate**: this crust was a king's, this bone a dinosaur's. Visitors gather, the curator weeps, and she continues to **narrate** until the plate is a museum exhibit.

The {Tailor} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} and finds an *attic* that fell through the ceiling. She stretches her *torso* across its dusty mattress and decides to **lie down** for a minute. A jet roars overhead; she doesn't care. The whole hangar staff joins her, all choosing to **lie down** in a row.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} melting *gold coins* in a pot on the mountain *ridge*. She pours them into moulds, but out comes grey **steel** instead. She builds a **steel** watering can so heavy that the hangar roof bends under it.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} with a long *hook*, dragging it across the yard. It scrapes a deep **ditch**, and *water drops* rush in from the sky. Boats slide off their racks and float down the **ditch** like ducks heading for the sea.

The {Juggler} climbs through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach}, where an *oddball* sits under a *roof* made of envelopes. He folds himself into a box and asks the Juggler to **send** him to the moon. The Juggler stamps the box, kicks it into the waves, and they **send** him off, bobbing toward the horizon.

The {Firefighter} trips down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and a slippery *husband* goes splat beside her. A giant *helping hand* reaches out to **help up** the husband, then her, then a fallen inflatable shark. Soon the hand has to **help up** everyone in the building, one by one, like a crane.

The {Pirate} climbs through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and opens a **shop** on a floating *seedbed*. He sells seeds for *gold coins*, plus goggles and parrot snacks. Swimmers paddle up to buy, and soon the pirate's **shop** is the busiest one in the pool.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Jungle}, where a *right hand* waves from the top of a *hillside*. It belongs to Mr **Deng**, who needs a filling. She climbs the hill, drills while monkeys hold the lamp, and Mr **Deng** smiles so wide the jungle echoes his name.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and finds a *longevity peach* bobbing on the water. He takes one bite and grows a long white beard down to his boots: **long life**! The fish nibble it too and swim off whistling, a hundred years old and wishing everyone **long life**.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Museum}, where a *toolbox* opens by itself and saws start to buzz. His *standing heart* jumps out of his chest, trembling with **fear**. The dinosaur skeletons shiver too, and everyone hides inside a mummy's coffin, chattering with **fear**.

The {Shepherd} trudges up the {Staircase} of the {Dunes} with a *small speech bubble* floating above her, asking every camel: "Where are my sheep?" She must **inquire** for *ten days*, bubble after bubble, until the sky is full of question marks. Finally a cactus answers, and she stops to **inquire** no more.

The {Tailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} stirring a cauldron of *soup* with a giant needle. The **soup** boils over and pours down the walls onto the planes. Pilots grab spoons, and the jets take off with their tanks full of **soup**.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower}, where a long *queue* of thieves lines up at a golden *dish*. Each one grabs a gem and passes it down the line: they **rob** the dish in seconds. The dentist yanks a gold tooth from the leader, and they **rob** her of her drill in return.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house, where a *python* curled up by the *moon* swallows a whole cake. The python swells round and **fat**, too big for the stairs. She tries pushing, pulling, hosing it, but the snake just gets more **fat**, and now it's eating the moon.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} with a spoon for the *taste test*. He dips it into the jet fuel, a puddle, a pilot's soup, and makes faces. "You must **taste** everything!" he cries, and the planes line up to let him **taste** their engines.

The {Tsar} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} palace as a *flapping flag* whips in the wind, signalling: hurry! He grabs his crown, his slippers and his breakfast in one **hurried** grab. He sprints, trips, and does everything in such a **hurried** rush that he jumps into the lagoon still in pyjamas.

The {Hunter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} as an *army* marches below with polished shields. A beam of *light* hits them and they **shine** so bright that patients shield their eyes. The Hunter polishes his rifle until it can **shine** too, and the whole roof glows.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} beside a *big man* bowing at an *altar*. "**How** do I win?" he asks. The altar shrugs. The big man asks again, "**How**?", and the ninja throws a coconut at him: problem solved.

The {King} sinks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and his robe bursts open. A *helping hand* rushes to sew a **button** back on, and a big *mouth* bites the thread. The **button** pops off again, ping, and lands in a fish's mouth, which swallows it and grins.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} into a grand *courtyard* where the emperor's **court** is in session. Two boxers fight beneath the throne while ministers take notes. The Tailor measures everyone for robes, and the whole **court** ends up in matching sequined gowns.

The {Ghost} floats up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a *maze* filled with *water drops*. At the centre a kangaroo hops in a puddle, holding a sign: **Australia**. The Ghost follows it out of the maze and finds the tower has drifted all the way to **Australia**.

The {Magician} stands on the {Front Step} of the {Spa} with a rope of *hemp* hanging from his *mouth*. He pulls and pulls out a never-ending rope. "**Obviously**," he shrugs, as if it's normal. The guests gasp, and he pulls out a towel too: "**Obviously**!"

The {Dentist} sinks into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hotel, where the *director* of the company sits in a bathtub. He bosses everyone with a rubber duck as a gavel, the board's **director**. The dentist checks his teeth, and the **director** pays her in seashells.

The {Cheerleader} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} as *thousand ants* march down the *road*, each carrying a coin. She waves her pom-poms to cheer them on as they **move** the whole bank across town. The building groans, lifts, and starts to **move** too, ants underneath like wheels.

The {Ninja} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} as *icicles* drip from the ropes. A boxer with a *puzzled face* tries to punch, but his fist starts to **freeze** mid-air. The whole crowd starts to **freeze** too, mouths open, until the arena is a museum of ice statues.

The {Wizard} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake}, where an *officer* holds a broken *heart* that won't stop crying. The officer pats it, the Wizard sings, and they wrap it in a warm blanket to **comfort** it. The lake ripples, the ducks hum, and the heart purrs, full of **comfort**.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} to the foot of a *cliff*, where a *dog* has fetched the same stick a thousand times. The *dog* finally drops it, rolls its eyes, and sighs: totally **fed up**. The Yogi is **fed up** too, so they both take a nap on the cliff.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} under the *moon* overlooking a *farmstead*, where pigs have rolled in oil. Everything is **dirty**: planes, pigs, the moon smeared with grease. She tries a bucket and sponge, but the pigs just get more **dirty**, and the moon wants a bath too.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} temple and sews wings onto the *moon*. The moon flaps, rises, and starts to **soar** over the treetops. Monkeys cling to its edges and **soar** with it, shrieking with joy, while the Tailor waves a needle.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse}, hidden behind a *mountain*, weaving a *silk pair* of slippers in perfect silence. No ducks, no boats, nobody: completely **secluded**. A fish peeks out, sees nobody, and sighs at how **secluded** it is.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mint}, where a *tossing sleeper* groans in bed, his *heart* full of grudges. Coins stamped with grumpy faces pile up around him. He tosses, he mutters, and he can't stop to **resent** his neighbour; every coin learns to **resent** him too.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} with a sheet of *rawhide* and a *jade tablet* to cut on. She makes a giant **shoe** for a yeti with bunions. It fits! The yeti stomps happily, and now every yeti wants a **shoe** with jade buckles.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel} with a *shoulder pole* full of teeth on her *elbow*. She trips, and the teeth scatter down the roof. "I **lose** everything!" she wails. The backpackers below catch them, but she manages to **lose** her drill too.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Island} lighthouse with a shovel to **bury** a treasure chest. He heaps *soil* over it, then a whole *village* moves in on top. Now the whole village wants to **bury** treasure, and the island is all lumps and grumbling pirates.

The {Cheerleader} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mint} and discovers a *wellspring* bubbling up through the coin press. Out spurt sparkling coins in a spring, splashing everywhere. She cheers, does a cartwheel, and drinks from the **spring**, and her pom-poms turn to silver fountains of the **spring**.

The {Yogi} sits in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} villa when *water drops* begin to rush through a *tunnel* in the wall. The water starts to **gush** in torrents, sweeping chairs and fish around her. She keeps meditating while the waves **gush** around her, floating serenely on the flood.

The {Shepherd} marches up the {Staircase} of the {Piazza} town hall pulling a *cart*, chasing a *pest* that steals sheep. She is mayor now and must **govern** everything: the pigeons, the fountain, the pest. She locks the pest in the cart and decides to **govern** with a crook as her sceptre.

The {Dentist} chases a patient into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse}. He tries to **hide** his *torso* behind a giant *flower*, petals over his head. She tiptoes past, sees a pair of shoes poking out, and shouts "Can't **hide** from flossing!"

The {Juggler} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Inn} wearing a *silver medal*, glinting like the *sun*. He juggles faster and faster, climbing up the stairs on the ball, to **advance** to gold. The innkeeper raises his flag, and the juggler continues to **advance** onto the roof.

The {Zookeeper} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Beehive} and points at *this spot* with a *silk skein*. She dyes every bee **purple**, then the honey, then the honeycomb. Soon the hive glows **purple** like a giant plum, and the bees buzz out grape-flavoured jam.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} trying to juggle with only a *right hand* while a banker's *glare* burns into him. It's **hard**: the coins fall, the wind howls. Every glare makes it more **hard**, until the juggler juggles the banker too.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} castle, where a *ghost* clutches a *wilting stalk* labelled **Wei**. "Restore the kingdom of **Wei**!" it moans. The Wizard waves his wand, the stalk sprouts, and a tiny kingdom grows on the water.

The {Wizard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and grabs a *speaker*. "**I**, the Wizard, am the greatest!" he booms, and the water ripples. Every swimmer shouts "**I**!" back, and the speaker squeals, unable to decide which loudmouth to believe.

The {Hunter} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Swamp} shack when his *standing heart* sees a *wasteland* where his lunch used to be. **Panic**! The heart runs in circles, bumps the chimney, and tumbles into the swamp. Frogs join the **panic**, croaking alarms.
